column1: # tier: sdk-order = named by SDK 2013's declaration order between datamap neighbours, type confirmed
#       doc       = an oracle document names this offset on this class (the evidence cites it)
#       walked    = named and typed by reading the bodies the evidence cites
#       unsettled = read, and the reading cannot decide (the evidence says why)
# `class` is the layout table the row belongs to (`CAI_BaseNPCTroika` for its whole chain, else the
# species class). One row per word; an aggregate (array, embedded struct) has a row at its first
# offset carrying the aggregate's type and count, and its touched elements rows of their own.
